title_en: Spot vs futures: you're not buying the same thing
title_zh: 现货和合约，买到的不是同一件事
goal_en: Tell holding an asset apart from holding a price contract, and understand long and short.
goal_zh: 区分持有资产与持有价格合约，理解做多、做空的方向。

shots.visual_en: Two identical BTC cards; one goes into a spot basket, the other into a futures ledger.
shots.visual_zh: 两张同样写BTC的卡片分别进入现货篮子和合约账本。

lines.en: They both say bitcoin. Isn't it the same trade?
lines.zh: 都写着比特币，不就是同一种买卖吗？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E18' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第18集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Spot vs futures: you're not buying the same thing
onscreen_text_zh: 现货和合约，买到的不是同一件事

shots.visual_en: Spot demo: pay USDT, receive BTC. Futures demo: a new position and a P&L column appear; no withdrawable BTC is added.
shots.visual_zh: 现货演示付出USDT获得BTC；合约演示新增仓位与盈亏栏，不新增可提取BTC。

lines.en: Plain spot, with no borrowing, swaps one asset for another. The linear perpetual we cover here is a contract position that settles profit and loss as the price moves. It's not buying bitcoin you can withdraw.
lines.zh: 没有借贷的普通现货，是用一种资产换另一种资产。这里讲的线性永续合约，则是持有按价格变化结算盈亏的合约仓位，不等于买到可提取的比特币。

shots.visual_en: The same price rises: long P&L goes positive, short goes negative; then the price falls and it flips.
shots.visual_zh: 同一价格上升，多头收益方向为正，空头为负；随后价格下降反转。

lines.en: Going long usually means hoping the price rises. Going short usually means hoping it falls. Get the direction wrong, and either side loses. Being able to short doesn't make it easier to make money.
lines.zh: 做多通常希望价格上涨，做空通常希望价格下跌。判断错了方向，两边都会亏。可以做空，不代表更容易赚钱。

shots.visual_en: A futures panel with only four fields: direction, size, margin, P&L. Beside it, an entry to the risk lessons.
shots.visual_zh: 合约面板只保留方向、数量、保证金、盈亏四项；新生看到风险课程入口。

lines.en: Should I level up from spot to futures?
lines.zh: 我应该从现货升级到合约吗？

lines.en: No need. Futures are a different risk structure, not a level you must reach. You can understand them and still choose not to use them.
lines.zh: 不用。合约是另一种风险结构，不是学习必须达到的等级；知道它是什么，也可以选择不用。

shots.visual_en: Plain spot is labelled 'no borrowing, no margin liquidation'; beside it, price-drop risk and platform risk.
shots.visual_zh: 普通现货标“无借贷不因保证金不足被强平”，另列币价下跌和平台风险。

lines.en: Plain spot without borrowing has no margin liquidation like futures do. But the asset can still lose a lot of value. No liquidation doesn't mean your money is protected.
lines.zh: 不借贷的普通现货没有合约那种保证金不足强平，但资产仍可能大幅贬值。不能因为没有强平，就说它保本。

onscreen_text_zh: 仍有：价格风险 · 平台风险

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Does opening a bitcoin contract add the same amount of withdrawable bitcoin to your account?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：开一个比特币合约，是否等于账户里多了同数量可提的比特币？

lines.en: Know what you're trading first. Then study leverage.
lines.zh: 先分清交易对象，再研究杠杆。

onscreen_text_zh: 合约 = 可提的BTC？ 不是

page_cta.line_zh: 合约是选修的风险课，本页不要求你开通合约。

exercise.task_en: Match spot asset balances and futures position fields to the correct pages.
exercise.task_zh: 将现货资产余额与合约持仓字段分别匹配到正确页面。
exercise.answer_en: A futures position is not the same as withdrawable base-coin assets. The course doesn't require a real account.
exercise.answer_zh: 合约仓位不等同于可提取的基础币资产；课程不要求真实开户。
